clear-sky.name: clear-sky
clear-sky.description: No observed clouds. UI shows Draw a cloud.

created-cloud.name: created-cloud
created-cloud.description: Created cloud (creator + 24h expiry) advects with wind; never merges with observed clouds.

dissipation.name: dissipation
dissipation.description: Clear obs #1 (t+5), #2 (t+10), #3 (t+16): only after #3 does the cloud dissipate and the note expire.

merge.name: merge
merge.description: A and B merge into M; both notes transfer exactly once, predecessors retire.

outage.name: outage
outage.description: Data gap > 30 min: cloud goes uncertain, content is held, nothing is deleted.

overcast.name: overcast
overcast.description: Broad cover; footprint shrinks on the east side but notes keep distinct anchors (no bbox rescale).

scattered-advection.name: scattered-advection
scattered-advection.description: Two clouds; west wind 10 m/s moves everything ~6 km east over 10 min.

split.name: split
split.description: M splits into S1 (west) and S2 (east); each note goes to exactly one child by containment.
